column10: This technology company develops integrated ICT solutions, specializing in blockchain, cybersecurity, IoT, and robotics software and hardware. This software development company specializes in cybersecurity solutions designed to protect user devices from malware attacks. Its core product line utilizes proprietary passive defense technology to inhibit unauthorized system access and secure digital environments. The firm focuses on the development and commercialization of these security tools to safeguard endpoints against evolving cyber threats across various computing platforms.

This technology firm specializes in passive bistatic radar systems that detect and track drones, birds, and aircraft by analyzing environmental electromagnetic signals like Wi-Fi and 5G. Utilizing AI-enhanced algorithms, the software-defined platform classifies targets and integrates with existing air traffic control and counter-unmanned aircraft systems. These solutions serve the aviation, defense, and critical infrastructure sectors, providing non-emitting surveillance capabilities for airports, government facilities, and industrial sites to ensure airspace security and wildlife management.

This technology provider specializes in cybersecurity software and smart infrastructure solutions. Its core offerings include encrypted data management platforms, BLE-based proximity systems, public Wi-Fi networks, and fiber optic sensing technology for environmental and utility monitoring. Serving sectors such as healthcare, banking, and public administration, the company has deployed over 1,000 integrated devices to support digital connectivity, geolocalized content delivery, and real-time infrastructure tracking across diverse urban and rural environments.

Operando come holding industriale, questa società fornisce servizi aziendali centralizzati, tra cui la gestione della tesoreria, l'amministrazione e il coordinamento logistico. Attraverso i suoi investimenti strategici, è specializzata nell'ingegneria di alta precisione e nella produzione di componenti meccanici per i settori aerospaziale, spaziale e della difesa. Azienda di ingegneria meccanica e difesa specializzata nella lavorazione meccanica generale e nella progettazione e produzione di veicoli subacquei speciali per applicazioni marine militari.

This technology company specializes in the research, engineering, and development of digital security systems. Its core product offerings focus on the secure acquisition and digitalization of sensitive data on mobile devices. By prioritizing data integrity, the company provides specialized technological solutions designed to protect information throughout the mobile capture process for clients operating within the digital security and mobile data sectors.

Aerospace manufacturing firm specializing in the production of standardized, highly maneuverable satellite platforms. The company develops proprietary propulsion and thrust vectoring systems utilizing 3D-printed components to facilitate in-orbit assembly, inspection, debris removal, and satellite repair. By streamlining production, the firm reduces satellite development cycles to approximately four months, providing essential hardware and mobility solutions for space missions and commercial satellite operators.

Aerospace technology firm specializing in the design and manufacturing of nanosatellites and integrated payloads. The company provides space-based telecommunications and Earth observation services, supporting the development of specialized space applications. By focusing on the production of CubeSats, the firm enables scalable orbital operations for diverse research and commercial sectors requiring compact, high-performance satellite infrastructure.
